items.label: TLS endpoints
items.purpose: Find public TLS certificate metadata on explicitly authorized hosts, addresses, and network ranges.
items.data_handling: Connects only to the normalized targets in the approved plan, performs a bounded TLS handshake, and stores public certificate metadata. It does not exploit services or collect private keys.

configuration.label: Explicit IP ranges
configuration.description: Bounded inclusive start-end address ranges crossed with the selected ports.

configuration.label: Ports
configuration.description: Individual ports or bounded ranges normalized before the scan is queued.

configuration.label: Excluded hosts and targets
configuration.description: Exact hostnames, addresses, or host:port destinations removed after normalization.

configuration.label: Excluded CIDR ranges
configuration.description: Address ranges removed after normalization; exclusions always win.

configuration.label: Excluded ports
configuration.description: Ports removed from every normalized target.

configuration.label: Allow approved RFC1918 targets
configuration.description: Permits private IPv4 targets already covered by the declared scope.

configuration.label: Allow loopback
configuration.description: Restricted local-testing override; never implied by private-range access.

items.label: SSH endpoints
items.purpose: Find public SSH host-key metadata on explicitly authorized machines and network ranges.
items.data_handling: Connects only to the normalized targets in the approved plan, reads the bounded SSH identification and host-key exchange, and stores public fingerprints. It never attempts a login.

items.label: Agentless SSH trust
items.purpose: Read effective SSH trust posture through an explicitly selected network relay and a restricted remote account.
items.data_handling: Authenticates only to pinned targets using vaulted PKCS#8 key references. Calls one fixed read-only helper; stores public trust evidence. No host agent is required. Match contexts and per-user keys are not assessed.

providers.label: Akeyless static secrets
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: an API-key auth method whose role may list the folder; the item listing carries no value. Content inspection also needs read on the items.

providers.label: 1Password Connect items
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a Connect server token with read access to the vaults to inventory; listing returns item titles, categories and tags only. Content inspection reads each item's fields.

providers.label: Doppler secrets
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a service account or personal token with read on the projects and configs; names come from the names-only endpoint. Content inspection reads each config's values once.

providers.label: Bitwarden Secrets Manager secrets
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a machine account with read access to the projects or secrets to inventory. Its access token signs in and carries the key that decrypts names on this side; the listing carries no value. Content inspection reads the values the account can read.

configuration.description: GitHub deployment environments whose secrets are listed too, or the Infisical environment slugs to list (empty: every environment of the project).

configuration.label: GitHub organization
configuration.description: Organization whose secrets are listed.

configuration.label: GitHub secret stores
configuration.description: Stores listed for the repository and organization: actions (the default), dependabot, codespaces.

configuration.label: Token owner's Codespaces secrets
configuration.description: Also list the Codespaces secrets of the user the token belongs to.

configuration.label: GitLab group
configuration.description: Group ID or full path whose CI/CD variables are listed; a project uses the project field.

configuration.label: GitLab instance variables
configuration.description: Also list the instance-level variables every project inherits (an administrator's token on a self-managed instance).

configuration.label: Client or access ID
configuration.description: An Infisical Universal Auth client ID or an Akeyless access ID; not a secret.

configuration.label: Client secret or access key reference
configuration.description: Reference to the Infisical client secret or the Akeyless access key; the value never enters source configuration.

configuration.label: Conjur account
configuration.description: The Conjur account the variables belong to.

configuration.label: Conjur login
configuration.description: The host (host/<id>) or user that signs in.

configuration.label: Conjur API key reference
configuration.description: Reference to the login's API key; the value never enters source configuration.

configuration.label: 1Password vaults
configuration.description: Vault IDs or names to list; empty lists every vault the Connect token can read.

configuration.label: Doppler configs
configuration.description: Configs of the Doppler project to list; empty lists every config.

configuration.label: Bitwarden identity endpoint
configuration.description: The identity service a self-hosted Bitwarden serves under /identity; Bitwarden's cloud identity service by default.

configuration.label: Inspect content for certificates and credentials
configuration.description: Explicit opt-in to retrieve candidate values into wipeable memory and emit certificate metadata and masked, fingerprinted API-key, token, and private-key findings only.

providers.label: AWS Secrets Manager
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: secretsmanager:ListSecrets. Optional content inspection additionally needs GetSecretValue on the filtered scope.

providers.label: Google Secret Manager
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: secretmanager.secrets.list. Optional content inspection additionally needs secretmanager.versions.access on the filtered scope.

providers.label: Azure Key Vault secrets
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: secrets/list. Optional content inspection additionally needs secrets/get on the filtered scope.

providers.label: HashiCorp Vault KV
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: list/read on the approved metadata path. Optional content inspection additionally needs read on the filtered data path.

providers.label: GitHub secrets (Actions, Dependabot, Codespaces)
providers.least_privilege: Metadata only: a fine-grained token with read access to each chosen store on the repository or org (Secrets for Actions, plus Environments for environment secrets; Dependabot secrets; Codespaces secrets), and Codespaces user secrets for the token owner's own. GitHub never returns values, so content inspection is refused.

providers.label: GitLab CI/CD variables
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a read_api token with at least Maintainer on the project or group, and an administrator's token for instance variables (GitLab returns values in the listing; trstctl wipes them unless content inspection is chosen). Hidden variables are never returned.

providers.label: Infisical secrets
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a machine identity with the Viewer role on each project to inventory, signing in with Universal Auth (client ID and client secret) or an access token. A metadata-only run asks Infisical to leave values out; content inspection asks for them.

providers.label: CyberArk Conjur variables
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a host (or user) with read on the variables to inventory, signing in with its API key; the resource listing returns only those and never a value. Content inspection also needs execute on them.

providers.label: Akeyless static secrets
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: an API-key auth method whose role may list the folder; the item listing carries no value. Content inspection also needs read on the items.

providers.label: 1Password Connect items
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a Connect server token with read access to the vaults to inventory; listing returns item titles, categories and tags only. Content inspection reads each item's fields.

providers.label: Doppler secrets
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a service account or personal token with read on the projects and configs; names come from the names-only endpoint. Content inspection reads each config's values once.

providers.label: Bitwarden Secrets Manager secrets
providers.least_privilege: Metadata: a machine account with read access to the projects or secrets to inventory. Its access token signs in and carries the key that decrypts names on this side; the listing carries no value. Content inspection reads the values the account can read.

items.label: Certificate Transparency
items.purpose: Watch public Certificate Transparency logs for certificates covering approved domains.
items.data_handling: Reads public CT entries and stores public certificate metadata and checkpoints.

configuration.label: Watched domains
configuration.description: Domains trstctl is authorized to monitor in public CT logs.

items.label: Credential drift
items.purpose: Compare current credential observations with the last approved state.
items.data_handling: Stores stable non-secret fingerprints and the exact changed metadata; it does not store credential values.

configuration.label: Watched credential metadata
configuration.description: Public or non-secret observations to compare across scans.

items.label: API keys and tokens
items.purpose: API keys and tokens discovery from bounded, sanitized observations.
items.data_handling: Inventory metadata and references for API keys and non-human tokens; raw token values are rejected.

configuration.label: Observations
configuration.description: One or more validated metadata-only observations.

items.label: Cross-system identities
items.purpose: Cross-system identities discovery from bounded, sanitized observations.
items.data_handling: Correlate the same non-human identity across identity providers, cloud, SaaS, code, and CI without collecting credential values.

configuration.label: Observations
configuration.description: One or more validated metadata-only observations.

items.label: OAuth grants
items.purpose: OAuth grants discovery from bounded, sanitized observations.
items.data_handling: Inventory OAuth application grants, scopes, owners, and consent risk without collecting client secrets or access tokens. Optional provider connections hold an admin token reference used only when an operator revokes a grant or blocks an app.

configuration.label: Observations
configuration.description: One or more validated metadata-only observations.

configuration.label: Provider
configuration.description: okta, microsoft or google: the provider an operator revokes grants or blocks apps at.

configuration.label: Admin API URL
configuration.description: The provider's admin API base URL (your Okta org URL, https://graph.microsoft.com, https://admin.googleapis.com).

configuration.label: Admin token reference
configuration.description: Reference only (env:NAME) to a token allowed to revoke grants and deactivate apps; the value never enters source configuration.

configuration.label: Allow approved private endpoint
configuration.description: Requires private-egress authorization and explicit CIDRs.

configuration.label: Approved private endpoint CIDRs
configuration.description: Private destinations allowed for this connection; metadata and loopback remain blocked.

items.label: Service accounts
items.purpose: Service accounts discovery from bounded, sanitized observations.
items.data_handling: Inventory Active Directory and cloud service-account metadata and credential references without collecting passwords or private keys.

configuration.label: Observations
configuration.description: One or more validated metadata-only observations.

items.label: Identity behavior
items.purpose: Identity behavior discovery from bounded, sanitized observations.
items.data_handling: Analyze bounded, sanitized use metadata for machine identities; credential material is rejected.

configuration.label: Observations
configuration.description: One or more validated metadata-only observations.

items.label: Compromise signals
items.purpose: Compromise signals discovery from bounded, sanitized observations.
items.data_handling: Ingest sanitized detector evidence and credential references; stolen credential values are rejected.

configuration.label: Observations
configuration.description: One or more validated metadata-only observations.

items.label: Privileged account sign-ins
items.purpose: Watch the accounts a dynamic-secret provider manages for sign-ins outside trstctl: each sign-in no session, check-out, rotation or health check explains becomes a compromised-credential finding (A274).
items.data_handling: Reads sign-in metadata only — the account, when, from where and how — through the provider's administrator connection: a host's sshd journal and auth log or Windows logon events, a database's current sessions. Never a credential or what a session did.

configuration.label: Provider
configuration.description: A dynamic-secret provider of the tenant whose static accounts are watched (a Linux, Unix or Windows host, PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server).

configuration.label: Lookback seconds
configuration.description: How far back each run reads (300 to 604800; default an hour). Overlapping runs refresh a finding, never repeat it.

items.label: Kubernetes TLS
items.purpose: Kubernetes TLS discovery from bounded, sanitized observations.
items.data_handling: Inventory Kubernetes Ingress and Gateway TLS metadata; Secret values and private keys are rejected.

configuration.label: Observations
configuration.description: One or more validated metadata-only observations.

items.label: Agent inventory
items.purpose: Receive signed, tenant-bound inventory from enrolled agents.
items.data_handling: Created by authenticated agent reports. The generic discovery-source API and wizard cannot declare this reserved source kind.

configuration.label: Enrolled agent
configuration.description: The enrolled agent that signs and reports the observation.

items.label: Manual evidence import
items.purpose: Import bounded public credential metadata from an approved offline workflow.
items.data_handling: Accepts metadata and non-secret fingerprints only; inline credentials are rejected.

configuration.label: Findings
configuration.description: Bounded public metadata records with provenance and fingerprints.
